digest.description.text: Cyris 摘要 {$date} {$period}：從 {$received} 篇文章中選出 {$included} 篇。

error.no_settings_store.text: 這個部署沒有可寫入的設定儲存區
error.no_settings_store.source: this deployment has no settings store to write

index.description.text: Cyris 摘要的每一期：從一組 RSS feed 和電子報挑出值得讀的文章，最新的在前。
index.description.source: Every issue of a Cyris digest: the articles worth reading from a set of RSS feeds and newsletters, newest first.

index.empty.text: 還沒有摘要。執行 {#code}cyris run{/code} 產生第一份摘要。
index.empty.source: No digests yet. Run {#code}cyris run{/code} to generate your first digest.

index.interest.text: 看看你投票過的標籤組成的{#link}興趣地圖{/link}。
index.interest.source: See the {#link}Interest map{/link} of the tags you vote on.

index.intro.text: Cyris 從 RSS feed 和電子報收集文章，挑出值得讀的編成摘要。最新的在前。每一期都有摘要，以及它判斷過的完整文章清單。
index.intro.source: Cyris collects articles from RSS feeds and newsletters and selects the ones worth reading into a digest. Newest first. Each issue has the digest and the full list of articles it judged.

interest.description.text: 你在 Cyris 投票過的文章標籤，一起出現的會連在一起，並標出每個壓制倒數還剩多少。
interest.description.source: The tags of the articles you voted on in Cyris, joined where they appear together, with how much of each suppression clock is left.

interest.empty.text: 投票過的文章還沒有標籤。投票後再執行 {#code}cyris run{/code}。
interest.empty.source: No voted article carries a tag yet. Run {#code}cyris run{/code} after you vote on articles.

interest.failed.source: Could not draw the interest map: {$reason}

interest.holds_elsewhere.text: 有壓制正在進行，但都不在這張地圖的標籤附近。
interest.holds_elsewhere.source: Suppressions are active, but none is near a tag on this map.

interest.intro.text: 你投票過的文章標籤，一起出現的會連在一起。
interest.intro.source: The tags of the articles you voted on, joined where they appear together.

interest.legend.text: 亮 = 正在壓制；越暗 = 剩下的時間越少；半色 = 沒有壓制。
interest.legend.source: Lit = suppressed now; dimmer = less time left; half colour = not suppressed.

interest.no_store.text: 興趣地圖要從 SQL 儲存區讀取投票和壓制：這個部署的 [store] backend 既不是 "sqlite" 也不是 "d1"。
interest.no_store.source: The interest map reads votes and holds from the SQL store: this deployment's [store] backend is neither "sqlite" nor "d1".

issue.degraded.text: 這一期有部分或全部內容沒有評分，或只是原文摘錄：這次執行時，設定的 LLM 沒辦法用在每個步驟。請到「設定」檢查供應商和金鑰。
issue.degraded.source: Some or all of this issue is unscored or plain excerpts: the configured LLM could not be used for every step this run. Check the provider and its key on Settings.

issue.empty.text: 這一期沒有內容：這次執行判斷了收到的 {$received} 篇文章，一篇也沒留下。

issue.empty_raw.text: 這一期沒有內容：這次執行判斷了收到的 {$received} 篇文章，一篇也沒留下。{#link}所有文章{/link}列出每一篇和它的判定。

issue.generated_by.text: 由 {#link}Cyris{/link} 產生 · {$tokens} 個 token · {$calls} 次 API 呼叫

raw.description.text: Cyris 摘要 {$date} {$period}判斷過的每一篇文章，依來源分組。
raw.description.source: Every article the {$date} {$period} issue of a Cyris digest judged, grouped by source.

raw.hint.text: 往左滑是少一點，往右滑是多一點；卡片在焦點上時，← 和 → 也一樣。點一下卡片會在新分頁開啟文章。
raw.hint.source: Swipe left for down, right for up; with the card focused, ← and → do the same. Tap the card to open the article in a new tab.

raw.intro.text: 這次執行判斷過的全部文章，加上還沒決定的。摘要只呈現其中一部分。
raw.intro.source: Everything the run decided on, plus what is still pending. The digest shows a selection of it.

raw.label.text: 所有文章 · {$articles} 篇文章 · {$sources} 個來源

vote.access_not_set_up.text: 這個部署還沒設定 Access。請管理者完成 Cloudflare Access 設定，再重新載入頁面。
vote.access_not_set_up.source: Access is not set up for this deployment. Ask the operator to finish the Cloudflare Access setup, then reload the page.

vote.not_configured.text: 這裡還不能投票：app Worker 沒有 CYRIS_PROMOTE_WORKER_URL。設定好後再投一次。
vote.not_configured.source: Voting is not set up here: the app Worker has no CYRIS_PROMOTE_WORKER_URL. Set it, then vote again.

vote.refused.text: 這一票沒有送出（HTTP {$status}）。請再試一次；如果一直失敗，請檢查 promote Worker。
vote.refused.source: The vote did not go through (HTTP {$status}). Try again; if it keeps failing, check the promote Worker.

vote.signed_out.text: 登入已經結束，這一票沒有送出。請重新載入頁面，再登入一次。
vote.signed_out.source: Your session has ended, so the vote was not taken. Reload the page and sign in again.

vote.unanswered.text: 伺服器沒有回應，這一票可能沒有送出。請檢查網路連線，再試一次。
vote.unanswered.source: No answer from the server, so the vote may not have been taken. Check your connection, then try again.
